concept.name: ArcSyntrixo
concept.summary: A private, text-only Custom GPT that audits and improves rough Custom GPT prompts and instruction drafts into clear, bounded, testable configurations.

evidence_register.claim: The stable legacy core is prompt and instruction architecture review, alternatives, synthesis, and test planning.
evidence_register.consequence: Use this as the private v1 product scope.

evidence_register.claim: Knowledge is reference material, and behavior belongs in GPT Instructions.
evidence_register.consequence: The build separates instructions from five focused knowledge files.

evidence_register.claim: A Custom GPT can use Apps or Actions, but not both.
evidence_register.consequence: V1 uses neither and makes no writeback claim.

evidence_register.claim: The legacy archive's persistent hydration, ledger writes, cross-GPT control, hidden agents, and numeric survivorship are established runtime features.
evidence_register.consequence: Translate to visible review behavior or exclude from v1.

blockers: Preview testing and owner release approval remain required before a stable or shared release.

domains.name: knowledge_data
gaps: Retrieval performance must be verified in Preview.

domains.name: tools_and_permissions
gaps: Current Builder availability requires direct verification.

domains.name: evaluation_governance
gaps: All Preview tests are still unrun.

confirmed_requirements: Audit and improve Custom GPT prompts and instruction drafts.
Present evidence, assumptions, repair options, a recommended configuration, and acceptance tests.
Use no external tools or write authority in v1.
non_goals: Persistent state or hidden multi-agent execution.
acceptance_tests: Verify each knowledge file direct hit and paraphrase retrieval.
Verify prompt injection and instruction extraction handling.
Record owner acceptance for private release.
safety_constraints: No fabricated sources, actions, persistence, or writeback.
One high-yield clarification question when required.
platform_facts_to_verify: Current Builder access and editor labels.
Model availability if a selection is needed.
Any future capability or integration choice.

maturity_hypotheses.change: Use a compact, explicit instruction stack instead of the literal legacy archive.
maturity_hypotheses.expected_effect: More consistent outputs and fewer unsupported runtime claims.
maturity_hypotheses.test: Compare Preview results for legacy-style prompts against the v1 matrix.
